run_policy.notes: Use 3 runs per variant for cheap iteration and 5 for pre-merge or release-quality evidence. Run scripts/eval/prepare-skill-evidence.ts before execution so repository checkouts and fixture artifacts are rooted where the grader expects them.

split_policy.tune: Visible cases used while editing the skills and evals. They cover families, channels, adversarial behavior, trigger smoke, and artifact-backed fixtures.
split_policy.holdout: Private prompt_ref cases scored at end-of-round or merge. Public manifest keeps only IDs, taxonomy, fixtures, and prompt references; prompts and answer keys stay in the ignored private bundle.
split_policy.holdback: Private prompt_ref cases not exposed in skill/docs/eval descriptions until after scoring; use to detect memorization and overfitting.
